paperTitle: Duda: The Little Tooth's Guardian - A Digital Game for Changing Deleterious Oral Habits
centralContribution: This work presents a novel methodology to promote the change of deleterious oral habits in children aged four to seven through an educational and transformational digital game titled "Duda: The Little Tooth's Guardian." The methodology integrates a seven-day interactive narrative based on the Hero's Journey, four distinct minigames, a points-based reward system, positive reinforcement strategies, and encourages collaborative participation from the child's family and dental professional.

units.title: Game's Central Contribution
units.summary: Novel methodology via 'Duda' game to change oral habits in children 4-7.

content.description: The paper's central contribution is the development and proposal of a novel methodology embedded in a digital game, 'Duda: The Little Tooth's Guardian,' designed to help children aged 4-7 overcome deleterious oral habits. This methodology uniquely combines a seven-day Hero's Journey narrative, diverse minigames, a points-based reward system, positive reinforcement, and engagement with family and dental professionals.

content.description: Deleterious oral habits persisting in children over three years old lead to significant physical and psychological issues. Existing interventions often lack engagement and continuous methods for the 4-7 age group to consciously abandon these habits. This paper introduces 'Duda: The Little Tooth's Guardian,' a digital game-based methodology designed as an engaging, playful, and continuous intervention to promote changes in these habits through an interactive narrative, minigames, and a reward system, involving family and dental professionals.
